g.title: BPD_QSP
g.text: Alveolarisation is a SCHEDULED programme, not a repairable tissue: injury does not destroy alveoli, it ARRESTS the septation clock while the window S_dev(PMA) keeps running out.

Antenatal hit + ventilator/oxygen exposure → NF-kB / IL-1b / TGF-b1 → suppression of the VEGF-NO-IGF1-retinoate growth gate G → alveolar + microvascular arrest → 36-week PMA support grade, BPD-PH, and the neurodevelopmental price of buying lung with steroid
